preamble: Delateralization with retraction, keeping ejectivity: the lateral ejective affricate *tɬʼ, preserved in Avar-Andic and Archi, became the velar ejective kʼ in Lak, Khinalug and most Lezgic languages, and uvular qʼ in Rutul and sometimes Lezgi. The lateral proto-segment rests on the Nikolayev–Starostin reconstruction, so certainty is moderate. A parallel shift of laterals to velars is known from other families.

examples.to: Lak tːarkʼ, Lezgi кӏараб kʼarab, Tabasaran kʼurab, Budukh kʼerepʼ
examples.note: Rutul qʼɨrɨb has the uvular variant.
Lezgi meqʼi, Rutul mɨqʼdɨ have qʼ.

sources: Nikolayev, S. L. & Starostin, S. A. (1994). A North Caucasian Etymological Dictionary. Asterisk. https://starlingdb.org
